properties.statement: Wrote a Python script over the exported design to build a per-project FEEDBACK LEDGER: for each reporting source (dev_storyflow, qs, Alex, chama, bhome, musicjug), which recorded defect facts carry an INVALIDATES edge from a ChangeEvent (fixed / partially fixed, read from the closing note's wording) versus none (open), and which exploratory ideas carry EVOLVES_INTO (built) versus none (awaiting a ruling). The owner asked 'have we addressed all feedback?' and nothing served answers it — find_tools returned gaps_to_prompts, confirmation_ledger and loop_status, none of which groups findings by the source that reported them with their fix status. The hand-rolled classifier also mis-flagged 'partial' wherever a closing note stated an honest bound, which a tool reading a structured field rather than prose would not.
